heading.title: Central and State Advisory Boards on Disability and District Level Committee

article.title: Vacation of seats by Members.
article.content:
63Vacation of seats by Members.

Section 63  ·  Chapter XI  ·  page 23 of the Act
If a Member of the Central Advisory Board becomes subject to any of the disqualifications specified in section 62, his seat shall become vacant.
